paragraphs.en: The moving seed vault stopped outside Sunreach at dawn.
paragraphs.zh: 移動種子庫在黎明停靠日衡城外。

paragraphs.en: A crate marked four hundred contained only twenty-eight living seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 一只標示四百粒的箱子只剩二十八粒活種子。

paragraphs.en: The first batch had passed through a warming circuit, yet the seeds stayed hard. Ilyas called the intact seals a decent sign; Nara said heat could dissolve wax without changing what lay beneath it. Her mentor suggested an inquiry rather than treating the clerk as an idiot. The nonprofit vault would implement a fresh inventory, because a numerical breakthrough meant nothing until another keeper could reproduce it.
paragraphs.zh: 第一批種子經過加溫電路，卻仍然堅硬。伊利認為封記完整是個還算不錯的跡象；娜拉說熱能溶掉蠟，卻不一定改變蠟下面的東西。她的導師建議展開調查，而不是把書記當笨蛋。這座非營利種子庫會重新清點，因為數字上的突破若不能由其他保管人重現，便毫無意義。

paragraphs.en: The ministry wanted the inventory corrected without an inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 部門要求不經檢查便修正庫存。

paragraphs.en: The placement of the crate beneath the projector gave the wall a false projection of abundance. Regardless of the water regime, Nara would reinforce its cracked rim before opening it again. A rider had left a saddle nearby; carrying too many samples had put strain on the animal. The idea that future losses might triple could terrify growers, so she refused to turn uncertainty into a prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 箱子放在投影機下方，讓牆上出現種子充足的錯誤投影。無論供水制度怎樣，娜拉都會先補強箱子的裂邊再打開。一名騎手把馬鞍留在附近；搬運過多樣本讓馬匹負擔沉重。未來損失可能增加三倍的想法足以嚇壞農友，因此她拒絕把不確定性說成預測。

paragraphs.en: Instead of offering a broad promise, Nara copied the seals and separated broken packets from intact ones.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉抄下封記，將破損紙包與完整紙包分開。

paragraphs.en: The clerk reached for a clean inventory sheet. Nara covered it with her hand. A replacement sheet would make the difference disappear before anyone had explained it. She asked him to keep the original on the table and bring the receiving receipt. Its total was four hundred too, but the handwriting changed halfway through the line. That was worth recording, not enough to accuse its writer.
paragraphs.zh: 書記伸手拿一張乾淨庫存表，娜拉用手蓋住。若換掉表格，差異還沒得到解釋就會消失。她請他把原件留在桌上，拿來收貨單。單上的總數也是四百，但同一行的筆跡中途變了。這值得記錄，卻不足以指控寫字的人。

paragraphs.en: Ilyas fetched a shallow counting tray. Together they divided the contents into groups, leaving the damaged packets in their own corner. When a gust lifted the receipt, the clerk caught it against his chest so quickly that Nara mistook his movement for an attempt to hide it. He looked hurt. She moved the paper beneath a glass weight and asked him to finish the count with them. His second total agreed with hers. Whatever had happened before their arrival, he had helped establish what was present now.
paragraphs.zh: 伊利取來淺盤，三人把種子分組清點，破損紙包另放一角。風掀起收據時，書記飛快把它按在胸前，娜拉一度以為他要藏起文件。他露出受傷的神情。她拿玻璃鎮紙壓好收據，請他一起完成清點。他的第二次總數與她相符。無論他們抵達前發生什麼，他至少協助確認了眼前的內容。

paragraphs.en: Rui wanted to know whether she could report that hundreds of seeds had been stolen. Nara pointed to the empty spaces on the tray. They showed an unexplained difference; they did not show a thief. Some seeds might have died, some packets might have been moved, and some numbers might never have described this crate. Rui crossed out one word, then asked for a photograph of the receiving receipt instead. Nara agreed after the clerk covered his personal address. Before the box was closed again, all three checked its new seal. The clerk kept a copy of the count. Nara took another, along with a drawing of the old wax. For the first time that morning, the two sheets disagreed openly rather than pretending to be one reliable account. The clerk asked to sign beside his own count, rather than beneath the unexplained old total.
paragraphs.zh: 芮問能不能報導數百粒種子遭竊。娜拉指著盤中的空位：它們顯示尚未解釋的差異，沒有指出小偷。種子可能死去，紙包可能移走，也可能原本的數字根本不是這只箱子的。芮劃掉一個詞，改問能否拍攝收貨單。書記遮住私人住址後，娜拉同意了。重新關箱前，三人都檢查新封記。書記留一份清點副本，娜拉帶走另一份及舊蠟封圖。那天早上，兩份文件終於公開承認彼此不同，而非假裝是一份可信的紀錄。 書記要求只在自己清點的數字旁簽名，不在未解的舊總數下簽。

paragraphs.en: The clerk found one gray fingerprint beneath the broken wax. Nara placed it in the margin of her sketch, where neither the ministry nor her own imagination could smooth it away.
paragraphs.zh: 書記在破裂封蠟下找到一道灰色指紋。娜拉把它畫在草圖邊緣，讓部門與她自己的想像都無法隨意抹平。

paragraphs.en: By the time the shadows lengthened, the missing amount became a question no one could erase.
paragraphs.zh: 影子拉長時，消失的數量成了無法隨意抹去的問題。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 1?
options: A corporation claimed a patent on a strain kept by four villages.
A proposed monopoly paired seed access with private water contracts.
A crate marked four hundred contained only twenty-eight living seeds.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「一只標示四百粒的箱子只剩二十八粒活種子」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara presented the limits of the experiments without offering political slogans.
Nara copied the seals and separated broken packets from intact ones.
Nara asked to see the source records before discussing any price.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉抄下封記，將破損紙包與完整紙包分開」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: That morning, a salt-flat settlement welcomed Nara with dry tea and silence.
paragraphs.zh: 那天早上，鹽地聚落以淡茶與沉默迎接娜拉。

paragraphs.en: Elder Tasa knew a buried variety survived in salty ground.
paragraphs.zh: 長者塔莎知道有一個古老品系能在鹽地存活。

paragraphs.en: Calling the old salt houses useless was absurd, Tasa said. Their architecture sheltered grain from adverse winds; only excessive pumping had damaged the land. A donor's new poster tried to highlight his generosity, but its ideology ignored indigenous growers. A visiting journalist promised careful journalism, and Nara offered access only after the residents approved what could be filmed.
paragraphs.zh: 塔莎說，把舊鹽屋稱為廢物十分荒謬。那些建築能遮擋不利的強風；真正傷害土地的是過量抽水。一名捐助者的新海報試圖突顯他的慷慨，背後的觀念卻忽視在地原生耕作者。一位來訪記者承諾謹慎報導，娜拉則表示，只有居民批准後才能拍攝。

paragraphs.en: Outsiders had collected samples without asking the village.
paragraphs.zh: 外人曾未經同意便取走村子的樣本。

paragraphs.en: An outsider offered Tasa a massage for her stiff hands, but she preferred to keep planting. Her quest was simple: let a living variety persist without inviting prosecution over old ownership claims. A damaged page would rip if lifted too quickly. Beside it lay a series of fish-trade stamps, including salmon from the coast; their variation in ink helped date the document rather than render the grower's memory irrelevant.
paragraphs.zh: 一名外地人想替塔莎僵硬的手按摩，但她寧願繼續種植。她的追尋很簡單：讓活著的品系延續，而不因舊所有權爭議招致起訴。破損紙頁若抬得太快就會撕裂。旁邊有一連串魚貨貿易戳記，包括來自海岸的鮭魚；墨色的差異有助於判定文件年代，而非使農友的記憶變得無足輕重。

paragraphs.en: Nara requested permission for three small soil jars.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉徵求帶走三小罐土樣的許可。

paragraphs.en: Tasa brought the jars to a low table and asked Nara which one would leave the village. Nara had expected a question about equipment. She put down the carrying case and explained that she hoped to take all three to the laboratory. Tasa moved one jar back toward herself. The last visitors had also promised to return what they borrowed. They had returned a report the village could not read.
paragraphs.zh: 塔莎把罐子帶到矮桌旁，問娜拉哪一只會離開村子。娜拉原以為她會問設備。她放下提箱，解釋自己希望把三只都送進實驗室。塔莎把一只拉回身邊。上一批訪客也承諾歸還借走的東西，最後卻只寄回村民看不懂的報告。

paragraphs.en: Nara opened the case again. There was room for two jars if the third remained here as a local comparison. That would make the experiment less convenient, but it would let Tasa check what had actually been removed. They tied matching threads around the lids and wrote down the depth and place where each soil sample had been taken. Tasa corrected the place names. Nara asked her to make those corrections on the laboratory labels as well, rather than hiding them on a private sheet. The younger keepers gathered close enough to see how the ties could be checked without opening the jars.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉重新打開箱子。若留下一罐供地方比對，箱中仍放得下另外兩罐。實驗會比較麻煩，塔莎卻能查核究竟帶走了什麼。她們在罐蓋綁上相同線結，記下每份土樣的深度與地點。塔莎更正地名，娜拉請她連實驗室標籤一起改，不把更正藏在私人紙頁上。年輕保管人靠近觀看，學習不開罐也能檢查線結的方法。

paragraphs.en: The laboratory messenger arrived with a printed receipt that described the contents as donated material. Nara drew a line through that description. Tasa was lending soil for a named test, not handing over a plant variety or permission to sell it. The messenger said he could not change the form. Nara shut the carrying case and left it on the table. After a long pause, he offered to take a revised receipt to his supervisor before collecting anything. Tasa kept the third jar beside her chair. Only then did she offer Nara a second cup of tea. It was still weak, but this time she asked whether the road to the laboratory would be rough enough to break the glass. Nara wrapped the glass separately before leaving; Tasa's permission would be useless if careless transport destroyed the comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 實驗室信使帶來印好的收據，把內容寫成捐贈材料。娜拉劃掉這個說法。塔莎借出土壤供指定測試，並未讓出植物品系或販售許可。信使說自己不能改表格，娜拉便關上箱子，留在桌上。沉默許久後，他表示可以先帶修訂收據請主管確認，再來領取樣本。塔莎把第三只罐子留在椅邊，這才替娜拉續茶。茶依然淡，但這次她問，通往實驗室的路會不會顛簸到震破玻璃。 離開前娜拉把玻璃罐分別包好；若粗心運輸毀掉比對樣本，塔莎的許可也會失去意義。

paragraphs.en: Tasa refused the reporter's first photograph, then placed the three jars in the sunlight herself. She wanted the village's permission to be seen, not merely its hardship.
paragraphs.zh: 塔莎拒絕記者拍下第一張照片，隨後親手把三只罐子放到陽光下。她希望村子的同意權被看見，而不只是困境。

paragraphs.en: Evening brought one measurable gain: Tasa permitted the test but not the transfer of seed ownership.
paragraphs.zh: 傍晚帶來一項可量測的進展：塔莎允許測試，卻沒有同意轉移種子所有權。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 2?
options: A cooling valve stuck and several treasured trays began to wilt.
Elder Tasa knew a buried variety survived in salty ground.
An elderly vendor showed a map of wells absent from the new atlas.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「長者塔莎知道有一個古老品系能在鹽地存活」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara requested permission for three small soil jars.
Nara checked landmarks on foot instead of repeating the rumor.
Nara cleared the room and let the plants go while the team fixed the pipe.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉徵求帶走三小罐土樣的許可」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: By the time the sun reached the eastern ridge, the old botanical school opened its courtyard to villagers.
paragraphs.zh: 太陽升到東方山脊時，舊植物學校把庭院開放給居民。

paragraphs.en: Two of three planted pots showed a pale root after a measured watering.
paragraphs.zh: 三盆種植實驗中有兩盆在定量澆水後長出淡色幼根。

paragraphs.en: The school's executive arrived with an attorney, expecting aggression from farmers protecting their beloved seed. Nara remained cautious. The biological difference between the pots was small, and one weak root might diminish by morning. She knew their argument was bound by the scope of the experiment: neither a fresh layer of soil nor a single promising shoot could establish a harvest.
paragraphs.zh: 學校主管帶著律師來到現場，預料保護心愛種子的農民會表現出攻擊性。娜拉仍保持謹慎。三盆之間的生物差異很小，一條虛弱的幼根明早也可能衰退。她知道論點受限於實驗範圍：無論新加一層土，還是出現一根有希望的幼芽，都不能證明必然有收成。

paragraphs.en: A council officer called the result a commercial miracle.
paragraphs.zh: 一名議會官員將結果稱為商業奇蹟。

paragraphs.en: A beetle became prey for a small bird outside the glasshouse, an ordinary scene of realism amid political speeches. Ilyas gave a shrug and used a shuttle to bring more water. He did not specialize in seeds, but he knew how to straighten a bent pipe and fasten its strap. Nara heard the timer tick; she recorded every viewpoint on a virtual board without letting the brightest screen replace the actual pots.
paragraphs.zh: 溫室外，一隻甲蟲成了小鳥的獵物；在政治演說之間，這是再真實不過的景象。伊利聳聳肩，用接駁車運來更多水。他不專精種子，卻知道如何拉直彎管、固定束帶。娜拉聽到計時器滴答作響；她把各種觀點記在虛擬看板上，卻不讓最亮的螢幕取代真正的陶盆。

paragraphs.en: After the arguments had been heard, Nara posted the water amounts and labeled the failed pot as prominently as the others.
paragraphs.zh: 各方意見都說完後，娜拉公布用水量，也同樣清楚地標示失敗的盆栽。

paragraphs.en: The officer asked Rui to stand where the empty pot would not appear in her photograph. Rui lowered the camera. Nara moved the three pots closer together, keeping their labels visible. If one was removed from the picture, readers would have no way to know that the same watering had produced different results. The officer said an encouraging image might secure money for another trial. Tasa asked what would happen when the next group expected every pot to grow.
paragraphs.zh: 官員請芮換個位置，別讓空盆進入照片。芮放下相機，娜拉則把三只盆移近，讓標籤都看得見。若照片少了一盆，讀者就無從知道同樣澆水得到不同結果。官員說，振奮人心的照片也許能爭取下一次試驗經費。塔莎問，下批參與者若期待每盆都發芽，該怎麼辦？

paragraphs.en: Ilyas brought the watering cup and set it beside the failed pot. A line scratched inside it marked the amount used that morning. The school gardener remembered that one pot had stood nearer the hot wall before the test began. Nara added that detail to its label, then asked whether the others had also been moved. Nobody could remember with confidence. The gardener offered to repeat the entire trial immediately. There were not enough prepared seeds for that, and Nara would not spend the reserve merely to obtain a tidier photograph.
paragraphs.zh: 伊利拿來量水杯，放在失敗的盆旁。杯內刻線標明早上用量。學校園丁想起，測試開始前，有一盆曾比較靠近熱牆。娜拉把這點補在標籤上，接著詢問其他盆是否也移動過。沒有人能確定。園丁願意立刻重做，但準備好的種子不足，娜拉不願只為取得好看的照片就消耗備用種子。

paragraphs.en: They placed the pots where the temperature could be compared and marked their positions on the ground. The gardener took responsibility for keeping them there until the next observation. Rui photographed his marked plan as well as the two roots. When the child approached with a cup, he stopped at the boundary instead of pouring extra water into the empty pot. Nara thanked him for asking first. More water might help, or it might change the only comparison they had. The child left his drawing beside the labels, giving the empty square as much space as the two living roots. The officer finally stepped aside. His proposed headline remained unwritten, while the gardener stayed to check the shade moving across the wall.
paragraphs.zh: 他們把盆放在可以比較溫度的位置，並在地面畫出標記。園丁負責在下次觀察前維持位置。芮除了兩條根，也拍下他的配置圖。孩子拿杯子走近，卻停在界線外，沒有直接替空盆加水。娜拉謝謝他先問。多澆水可能有幫助，也可能改變唯一的比較條件。孩子把畫放在標籤旁，讓空格與兩條活根占有一樣大的位置。官員終於讓開；他想要的標題仍未寫出，園丁則留下查看牆上的陰影如何移動。

paragraphs.en: At sunset, the team could finally state a limited outcome: the village gained a repeatable observation rather than a promise of harvest.
paragraphs.zh: 日落時，團隊終於能說出有限成果：村民得到的是可重複的觀察，而不是收成保證。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 3?
options: Two of three planted pots showed a pale root after a measured watering.
Identical seeds responded differently to salt and soil organisms.
The filtered water passed visual tests but still needed chemical analysis.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「三盆種植實驗中有兩盆在定量澆水後長出淡色幼根」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara published the failed trays and the measurement uncertainty.
Nara refused to irrigate edible crops until the remaining tests were complete.
Nara posted the water amounts and labeled the failed pot as prominently as the others.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉公布用水量，也同樣清楚地標示失敗的盆栽」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: A dust storm met the caravan on the eastern service road.
paragraphs.zh: 沙塵暴在東側補給路迎上車隊。

paragraphs.en: The clinic and seed carriers shared the last usable shelter.
paragraphs.zh: 診所人員與運種車隊必須共用最後一處能用的避難棚。

paragraphs.en: The clinic's driveway was crowded with freight carts, not visitors seeking relief from boredom. A civic guideline put shelter before cargo, but the dispatcher pleaded that moving patients would prolong delivery. Tasa spoke with an eloquent calm that cut through despair. She said an innovative shelter could protect the seed cases too, if the drivers stopped arguing long enough to build it.
paragraphs.zh: 診所車道擠滿了貨車，並不是來此排遣無聊的人。公民指引要求先安置人員、再處理貨物，但調度員懇求不要延長送貨時間。塔莎用流暢而平靜的話語打破絕望。她說，只要司機停止爭吵片刻，一個有創意的避難棚就能同時保護種箱。

paragraphs.en: A driver insisted that the archive should outrank sick travelers.
paragraphs.zh: 一名駕駛堅稱種子庫比生病旅客更重要。

paragraphs.en: The storm would intensify, and the shortage of housing became noticeable. A nurse checked each person's medication while a boy began to vomit from the heat. Nara opened a tin of clean cups and asked a driver to wipe the windshield. Morality was not an abstract trait here: a little water might stimulate recovery, while a reckless departure could put everyone in danger. The driver did not plead for special treatment; he asked for a safer road.
paragraphs.zh: 風暴可能增強，住宿不足也愈來愈明顯。護士檢查每個人的藥品，一個男孩因高溫開始嘔吐。娜拉打開一只裝有乾淨杯子的錫盒，請司機擦淨擋風玻璃。此處的道德並不是抽象特質：一點水或許有助恢復，魯莽出發卻可能讓所有人涉險。 駕駛沒有懇求特殊待遇，只要求一條更安全的道路。

paragraphs.en: Instead of offering a broad promise, Nara delayed the journey and opened a dry storage bay for the patients.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉延後旅程，開放乾燥貨艙供病患休息。

paragraphs.en: Opening the storage bay meant moving three heavy cases out of the way. The driver who had argued for the seeds held his arms across the first one. Its contents had survived two failed journeys, he said. Nara did not ask him to abandon it in the storm. She showed him the dry space beneath the raised loading ramp and asked whether his crew could secure the cases there while the patients rested inside.
paragraphs.zh: 開放貨艙就得先移走三只重箱。先前主張保護種子的駕駛攔住第一只，說裡面的東西已挺過兩趟失敗旅程。娜拉沒有要他把箱子丟進風暴。她指著升高裝貨坡道下的乾燥空間，問他的隊員能否把箱子固定在那裡，讓病患進艙休息。

paragraphs.en: The nurse inspected the bay before agreeing. A strong smell from an old fuel container made one corner unsuitable, so Ilyas removed the container and opened the upper vents. The driver found a clean sheet to hang between the resting area and the cargo. His hands shook while he fastened it. He explained that his own brother had once lost a season's seed during an emergency. Nara understood his anger better now, though it did not change which people needed shelter first. She asked him to help her check the cases after everyone had been moved.
paragraphs.zh: 護士先檢查貨艙才答應。舊燃料桶使一角氣味強烈，不適合休息，伊利便搬走容器，打開上方通風口。駕駛找到乾淨布單，隔開休息區與貨物，綁布時雙手發抖。他說，自己的哥哥曾在一次緊急事件裡失去整季種子。娜拉更明白他的憤怒，但這不會改變誰最需要先進避難處。她請他等人員安置好，再陪她一起檢查種箱。

paragraphs.en: A wheel jammed against the ramp just as the wind pushed sand through the yard. Instead of sending a sick traveler back outside, the crew passed the remaining medicine through a side opening. The nurse counted each parcel as it reached her. When the last patient was seated, the driver showed Nara the ropes around the cases. None had loosened. He had protected his cargo without closing the bay to the people beside it. Later, the boy searched for the dog and tried to share his drink. Watching Nara fetch a separate bowl, the driver quietly brought another cup for the nurse. They would still arrive late. For that afternoon, at least, lateness had bought something more useful than an argument about whose loss mattered most. Before departure, the nurse checked the count again. Every medicine parcel had reached the bay, including the one passed through the side opening.
paragraphs.zh: 風把沙吹進院子時，一只輪子卡住坡道。隊員沒有叫病人重新出去，而是從側邊開口傳進剩餘藥品，護士逐包清點。最後一位病人坐下後，駕駛帶娜拉看綁住箱子的繩索，沒有一條鬆脫。他保護了貨物，也沒有把身邊的人擋在艙外。稍後男孩找狗分享飲水，看著娜拉另外拿水碗，駕駛默默替護士添一杯水。他們仍會遲到，但至少這個下午，遲到換來的東西，比爭論誰的損失比較重要更有用。 出發前護士再次清點。每包藥都已送進貨艙，包括從側邊開口傳進的那包。

paragraphs.en: By the time the shadows lengthened, the medicine arrived intact and the samples stayed sealed.
paragraphs.zh: 影子拉長時，藥品完整送達，種子樣本也保持封存。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 4?
options: A newly planted tray would need more water than the schedule allowed.
The broken valve contained metal unlike the approved design.
The clinic and seed carriers shared the last usable shelter.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「診所人員與運種車隊必須共用最後一處能用的避難棚」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Ilyas compared the maker's marks with purchase and repair records.
Nara delayed the journey and opened a dry storage bay for the patients.
Nara limited the next trial to twelve cells and requested public counters.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉延後旅程，開放乾燥貨艙供病患休息」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: That morning, families filled a meeting hall beside the public cistern.
paragraphs.zh: 那天早上，居民擠滿公共蓄水池旁的集會廳。

paragraphs.en: The permit for the first planting had a water seal but no measured quota.
paragraphs.zh: 第一批播種許可有水印，卻沒有測量過的配額。

paragraphs.en: Attendance at the hall exceeded the council's estimate. One resident displayed a bruise received while defending the public tap, and others began to contend over who should control it. A contemporary corporation offered to endorse the new planting ritual in exchange for advertising. Nara said the essence of the proposal was controversial: it would facilitate publicity, not equitable water access.
paragraphs.zh: 到場人數超過議會估計。一名居民展示自己保護公用水龍頭時留下的瘀傷，其他人開始爭論誰該控制水源。一間當代企業表示願意支持新播種儀式，條件是換取廣告。娜拉說提案的核心很有爭議：它方便的是宣傳，不是公平取水。

paragraphs.en: The merchant council demanded an immediate demonstration.
paragraphs.zh: 商人議會要求立刻公開示範。

paragraphs.en: The irony was that the company's offering included a beautiful outfit for the ceremony but no measurement tools. Nara asked for the overall cost, divided it into a segment for pipes and another for repairs, and demanded a statistical estimate. From the perspective of the poorest homes, a transition to paid private wells would be a loss, no matter how impressive the public celebration appeared. Tasa would defy any vote that stole a village's right to refuse.
paragraphs.zh: 諷刺的是，公司的奉獻包括一套漂亮的典禮服裝，卻沒有任何測量工具。娜拉要求提出總成本，把它分成管線與維修部分，並索取統計估算。從最貧困家庭的角度看，轉向收費私人水井將是損失，不管公開慶典看起來多麼風光。 塔莎會反抗任何奪走村落拒絕權的表決。

paragraphs.en: Nara asked the growers to vote on a temporary hold and a shared water count.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉請農友對暫緩播種及共同清點用水進行表決。

paragraphs.en: The chalk marks on the wall were shorter than the line printed on the company's display. A council assistant said the woman must have counted incorrectly. She opened her bag and took out the small container her household used every morning. Its handle had been repaired with wire. Nara asked the assistant to fill it from the public tap while the woman watched. Nobody had brought a vessel large enough to check the display's claim directly.
paragraphs.zh: 牆上的粉筆線比公司展示板上的短。議會助理說，老婦一定算錯了。她從袋裡拿出家中每天使用的小水桶，提把用鐵絲修過。娜拉請助理當著老婦的面從公共水龍頭裝水。現場沒有人帶來足以直接查核展示數字的大容器。

paragraphs.en: Ilyas found a measuring jug in the kitchen. Water from the household container did not reach the level the company called a standard allowance. The assistant began explaining that pressure varied between streets. That was precisely why a number on a poster could not settle the question. Nara asked for readings at the tap rather than an estimate based on the new pump's advertised capacity. The company representative offered to discuss the difference privately after the demonstration. The woman remained beside her chalk marks, waiting for an answer the whole hall could hear.
paragraphs.zh: 伊利在廚房找到量壺。家用水桶倒出的水，沒有達到公司所稱的標準配額。助理解釋各街水壓不同，這正好說明海報數字無法解決問題。娜拉要求水龍頭實際讀數，而非根據新水泵宣傳容量估算。公司代表願意等示範結束後私下討論差異，老婦卻站在粉筆線旁，等一個全廳都聽得見的回答。

paragraphs.en: Before the vote, Tasa asked whether a temporary hold would mean that families could no longer collect drinking water. Nara wrote two separate decisions on the board: household supply would continue, while the proposed planting demonstration would wait for a shared count. The assistant read both aloud. Several hands that had remained low during the argument now rose. Afterward, the woman drew another line beside her first one, using the amount they had actually measured. She did not erase the old line. The gap between them gave the local auditors their first task. Outside, the company workers folded their ceremonial cloth while the kitchen staff kept the jug on the counter. Tomorrow's visitors would need something they could fill, empty, and compare for themselves. The kitchen manager asked who would keep the measuring jug clean between visits. The assistant accepted that small duty and wrote his name beside it. The first shared check now had both a tool and someone responsible for making it usable.
paragraphs.zh: 表決前，塔莎問，暫緩是否意味家庭也不能領飲水。娜拉在板上分開寫兩項決定：家用供水繼續，規劃中的播種示範則等共同清點後再進行。助理把兩項都朗讀出來。原先在爭論中沒有舉起的幾隻手，此時升起。表決後，老婦按實際量到的水量，畫出另一條線，沒有擦掉舊線。兩線之間的差距成了地方查核員的第一項工作。外面，公司員工收起典禮布，廚房人員把量壺留在櫃臺。明天的訪客需要的是能親手裝滿、倒空、比對的東西。 廚房主管問訪客來訪之間誰清洗量壺。助理接下這件小事，把名字寫在旁邊。第一次共同查核如今有了工具，也有人負責維持工具可用。

paragraphs.en: Evening brought one measurable gain: the vote protected the remaining seed and authorized a local audit.
paragraphs.zh: 傍晚帶來一項可量測的進展：表決保護了剩餘種子，也授權地方查核。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 5?
options: Each community wanted a different limit on seed sharing.
The permit for the first planting had a water seal but no measured quota.
The seed-sharing page lacked signatures that the village book remembered.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「第一批播種許可有水印，卻沒有測量過的配額」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara asked the growers to vote on a temporary hold and a shared water count.
Nara copied both registers without declaring either one genuine.
Nara proposed a cooperative with an explicit right to withdraw.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉請農友對暫緩播種及共同清點用水進行表決」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: By the time the sun reached the eastern ridge, the caravan reached a frontier where wells stood behind locked fences.
paragraphs.zh: 太陽升到東方山脊時，車隊抵達一處水井全被柵欄封鎖的邊境。

paragraphs.en: Families were buying drinking water with irrigation credits.
paragraphs.zh: 家庭正以灌溉點數購買飲水。

paragraphs.en: An abrupt order reached the frontier through a messenger with a briefcase. A local activist asked Nara to contemplate the cost of refusing it. The water company called itself a separate entity, while its hostile guards treated a family in exile as trespassers. Farther down the road, an old injection clinic was closed, and the last medical worker feared the loss of emergency power.
paragraphs.zh: 一名攜帶公事包的信使把突然下達的命令送到邊境。地方行動者請娜拉仔細想想拒絕命令的代價。供水公司自稱是獨立法人，敵意十足的守衛卻把流亡家庭當成闖入者。道路另一端的舊注射診所已關閉，最後一位醫護人員害怕緊急電力也會中斷。

paragraphs.en: The prefect threatened to arrest anyone who changed the schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 地方長官威脅逮捕任何更動供水表的人。

paragraphs.en: The prefect praised masculine courage and called the villagers naive. Tasa replied that courage did not cancel an obligation to protect children. A shop's only outlet faced the pedestrian path, and its owner promised to repay anyone hurt by the water delay. Nara proposed a public seminar, where two caretakers could supervise readings and measure the surplus rather than letting a single official claim it. The new order threatened to disrupt the clinic's supply route. A courier held a cold cloth against his injured thigh.
paragraphs.zh: 地方長官讚美陽剛的勇氣，並說村民太天真。塔莎回答，勇氣不能免除保護孩子的責任。一家店唯一的出口面向行人道，店主承諾補償因延後供水而受傷害的人。娜拉提議舉辦公開說明會，由兩名保管員監督讀數並測量剩餘水量，而不是任由一名官員宣稱掌握一切。 新命令可能中斷診所的補給路線。 一名信使把冷布壓在受傷的大腿上。

paragraphs.en: After the arguments had been heard, Nara asked an activist and a well keeper to witness the meter together.
paragraphs.zh: 各方意見都說完後，娜拉請一名行動者與井管員共同見證水錶。

paragraphs.en: The well keeper would not open the meter box while the activist stood beside him. He said the last inspection had ended with stones thrown at his office. The activist answered that the office had closed its shutters while families waited outside. Nara asked each to choose one person who could stand close enough to read the dial. Neither liked the other's choice, but both knew the two chosen witnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 行動者站在旁邊時，井管員不肯打開水錶箱。他說上次檢查最後有人向辦公室丟石頭。行動者回答，當時家庭在外等候，辦公室卻關上窗。娜拉請雙方各選一人，靠近讀錶。他們都不喜歡對方的人選，但都認識被選出的兩位見證人。

paragraphs.en: Ilyas checked that the dial was turning before they wrote anything down. A stopped meter could produce a perfectly neat account of water that had never been counted. One witness called out the figures; the other repeated them while the keeper entered the time. They changed places for the second reading. The figures matched, yet the increase was smaller than the amount charged to the households waiting at the fence. The keeper pointed to a separate pipe leading toward the clinic. Nobody had recorded whether its flow was included in the same total.
paragraphs.zh: 記錄前，伊利先確認錶盤正在轉動。停止的水錶也能替從未計量的水做出整齊帳目。一人念數字，另一人複誦，井管員記下時間；第二次讀取時兩人交換位置。數字相符，但增加量少於柵欄外家庭被收費的數量。井管員指向診所的另一條管線，沒有人記錄它是否納入同一總數。

paragraphs.en: The activist wanted the gate opened immediately. The keeper said he would lose his post. Nara asked them to leave the pipe untouched until someone could explain its route, while preserving the households' existing collection times. That did not give the families enough water, and several told her so. She put their complaint beside the readings rather than calling the visit a success. Before leaving, the witnesses each took a copy, and the keeper kept the original inside his office window where it could be read from the street. The activist handed his spare hat to the guard still standing in the sun. It was a small kindness between people who remained opposed. The numbers on the glass gave them a reason to meet again without pretending that the argument had ended.
paragraphs.zh: 行動者要求立刻開門，井管員說那會使自己失去工作。娜拉請他們先別動管線，等人查清走向，同時保留家庭原有取水時段。這仍不足以滿足家庭所需，幾名居民直接告訴她。她把抱怨寫在讀數旁，沒有把訪查稱為成功。離開前，兩名見證人各拿一份副本，井管員把原件放在辦公室窗內，街上的人也能閱讀。行動者把備用帽子遞給曬太陽的守衛。這是立場仍對立的人之間一點善意。玻璃上的數字讓他們有理由再見，不必假裝爭論已結束。

paragraphs.en: At sunset, the team could finally state a limited outcome: two independent readings exposed a gap in the official totals.
paragraphs.zh: 日落時，團隊終於能說出有限成果：兩份獨立讀數顯示官方總量有缺口。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 6?
options: Families were buying drinking water with irrigation credits.
Farmers had documented decades of careful seed selection there.
A sudden wind buried the route markers and overturned a cart.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「家庭正以灌溉點數購買飲水」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara asked each keeper whether the old consent extended to commercial breeding.
Nara sent the search party to the driver and marked the crates for later recovery.
Nara asked an activist and a well keeper to witness the meter together.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉請一名行動者與井管員共同見證水錶」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: A narrow canal divided the orchard district from the dry quarter.
paragraphs.zh: 一條狹窄水渠隔開果園區與乾燥街區。

paragraphs.en: The same water delivery appeared twice in two ledgers.
paragraphs.zh: 同一批送水量在兩本帳上出現兩次。

paragraphs.en: The double billing could arouse controversy among the canal workers. An array of old photographs showed a dark corridor beneath the intake station, but none proved the company corrupt. Nara asked who held custody of the originals and whether the extra charge might derive from a disconnected meter. Ilyas refused to disconnect anything until a technician with the right expertise arrived.
paragraphs.zh: 重複計費可能在水渠工人之間引起爭議。一系列舊照片顯示取水站下方有一條陰暗走廊，但沒有一張能證明公司腐敗。娜拉詢問誰保管原件，以及額外收費是否源自一個脫線的水錶。伊利拒絕在具備專業技術的人抵達前拆除任何裝置。

paragraphs.en: A union blamed the orchard workers while owners blamed strangers.
paragraphs.zh: 工會怪罪果園工人，業主則怪罪外來者。

paragraphs.en: A clean water supply was indispensable, especially when damaged infrastructure could infect a whole village. The labor league wanted to blame a mysterious pirate who sold stolen water credits. Instead, Nara recorded the actual recipient of each payment. She authorized removal of a broken valve, then checked whether the replacement was sturdy enough for the next irrigation tournament at the farmers' fair. The careful work was worthwhile. The fair's cuisine depended on vegetables grown beside the canal.
paragraphs.zh: 乾淨水源不可或缺，尤其當受損基礎設施可能讓整個村莊遭感染時。工會想怪罪一名販賣偷來點數的神祕水賊。娜拉則記下每筆款項真正的收款人。她准許拆除壞掉的閥門，再檢查替代品是否夠堅固，能應付農民市集下一場灌溉競賽。這樣謹慎的工作值得付出。 市集的菜餚仰賴水渠旁種植的蔬菜。

paragraphs.en: Instead of offering a broad promise, Nara traced the meter photographs through the village committee.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉透過村委會追查水錶照片。

paragraphs.en: The two receipts had different headings but the same stain near the bottom. Rui laid them side by side and asked whether they were simply copies. The orchard worker shook his head. His family had paid both bills because one office called its charge delivery and the other called it access. He had thought refusing either payment would close the channel to his trees.
paragraphs.zh: 兩張收據的標題不同，底部卻有相同汙漬。芮把它們並排，問是否只是副本。果園工人搖頭。他家兩筆都繳，因為一間辦公室稱它為運送費，另一間稱為使用費。他以為拒繳任何一筆，果樹的水渠都會被關閉。

paragraphs.en: Nara asked him to mark the dates on a calendar. The deliveries fell on the same morning. Ilyas compared the meter photographs, looking for signs that one had been taken before the other. A loose wire appeared in exactly the same position in both pictures. That supported a connection between the accounts, though it did not explain who had requested the second payment. The committee clerk brought a book showing how money moved between the offices. Its page for that week had been corrected in a different ink. He placed it on the table himself and stayed while they copied it.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉請他在日曆標日期，兩筆送水都落在同一天早上。伊利比對水錶照片，查看有無一張先拍、一張後拍的跡象。兩張圖裡鬆掉的電線位置完全一樣，支持兩筆帳互有關聯，卻不能解釋誰要求第二次付款。委員會書記帶來辦公室間款項流動的帳本。那週的頁面用另一種墨水改過。他主動把它放上桌，留下來陪他們抄錄。

paragraphs.en: An owner offered to refund the worker if the discussion stopped there. The worker almost agreed; he needed the money for a replacement valve. Tasa asked whether the neighboring households would receive the same offer. The owner had brought cash for only one family. Nara separated the immediate refund from the wider inquiry. Accepting money already owed should not require the worker to destroy the evidence or speak for everyone else. They copied his receipts before he took them home. At the door he began to tear the duplicate, then passed it back for safekeeping. The refund could repair one valve. Keeping the paper intact might help explain why an entire street had been charged for water it received only once. The clerk numbered the copied pages before returning the book to its shelf. A loose photograph would be easy to separate from the account it described. Rui included the page numbers in her notes, giving the committee a way to find the same entries again.
paragraphs.zh: 一位業主願意退款，只要討論到此為止。工人差點答應，他需要錢換閥門。塔莎問鄰近家庭是否也能得到同樣安排，業主卻只帶了一戶的現金。娜拉把立即退款與整體調查分開。拿回本來就欠他的錢，不應要求他銷毀證據或替所有人發言。他們先複印收據，才讓他帶回家。門口，他一度想撕掉重複收據，最後交回保管。退款能修一個閥門，完整保存紙張，或許能解釋整條街為何收到一次水卻付兩次錢。 書記把副本編頁才將帳本歸架。散落照片很容易與它描述的帳目分離，芮把頁碼也寫進筆記，讓委員會日後能找到同樣條目。

paragraphs.en: By the time the shadows lengthened, the duplicate charge was real but its author remained unknown.
paragraphs.zh: 影子拉長時，重複計費確實存在，但究竟由誰填入仍不清楚。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 7?
options: A proposed monopoly paired seed access with private water contracts.
Thirteen seedlings emerged in a measured row after ten days.
The same water delivery appeared twice in two ledgers.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「同一批送水量在兩本帳上出現兩次」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara counted surviving leaves and posted the next month's water needs.
Nara traced the meter photographs through the village committee.
Nara presented the limits of the experiments without offering political slogans.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉透過村委會追查水錶照片」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: That morning, the seed exchange opened beneath a painted market canopy.
paragraphs.zh: 那天早上，種子交換會在彩繪市集棚下開幕。

paragraphs.en: A corporation claimed a patent on a strain kept by four villages.
paragraphs.zh: 一家公司聲稱擁有四個村落保存品系的專利。

paragraphs.en: Nara treated every offer with caution. Her first chore was to obtain clarity about what counted as a commodity and what remained communal knowledge. A delegation of growers asked her to dedicate time to their stories, even when the company called their concerns dreadful. An ethical exploration of seed history required fluency in several village languages, not merely the vocabulary of lawyers.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉謹慎看待每個提議。她首先要釐清什麼算商品，什麼仍是社群共有知識。一個農友代表團請她花時間聽故事，即使公司把他們的疑慮說得很糟。合乎倫理的種子歷史探索，需要熟悉數種村落語言，而不只是律師的專業用語。

paragraphs.en: Its lawyer offered to purchase every surviving packet.
paragraphs.zh: 公司律師提出收購所有存活種包。

paragraphs.en: Inside the market, a generator hummed beside a painted interior wall. The firm promised a patent premium that would let the cooperative shed its debt, but demanded sole control of breeding. Tasa tried to steer the talk toward consent. Some traders called the old rules superstition; a visiting undergraduate asked for a public venue where keepers could answer without losing their rights. Solar panels could generate power, but they could not generate consent.
paragraphs.zh: 市場裡，一台發電機在彩繪內牆旁嗡嗡作響。公司承諾提供專利溢價，讓合作社擺脫債務，卻要求獨占育種控制權。塔莎試圖把話題帶回同意權。有些商人把舊規矩叫迷信；一名來訪的大學生則要求公開場地，讓保管人能回答問題而不失去權利。 太陽能板可以發電，卻無法創造同意。

paragraphs.en: Nara asked to see the source records before discussing any price.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉要求先查看來源紀錄，再談價格。

paragraphs.en: The lawyer spread a printed certificate across the market table. Four village names appeared beneath the company's name, as if the order of the words could settle who had created the strain. Tasa placed her cloth label beside the certificate. Its spelling differed from the printed version. The lawyer called that a minor variation. A second keeper said it identified the village where her grandmother had first obtained the seed.
paragraphs.zh: 律師把印好的證書攤在市集桌上。四個村名列在公司名稱下面，彷彿字的順序就能決定誰培育了品系。塔莎把布標放在證書旁，拼法與印刷版本不同。律師說這只是小差異。另一位保管人卻說，那個名字指出祖母最初取得種子的村子。

paragraphs.en: Nara asked for the records that connected those labels to the company's application. The lawyer produced a purchase receipt signed by a trader. The trader had sold a bag of grain; nothing on the page said he had authority to sell a community's breeding knowledge. That absence did not by itself decide the claim. It did mean that the price now being offered could not answer the question the keepers were asking. Rui wrote down the difference between buying a physical packet and claiming control over every future crop descended from it.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉要求查看連結布標與公司申請的紀錄。律師拿出商人簽名的收據。商人賣了一袋穀物，紙上卻沒有說他有權販售社群的育種知識。這項缺漏本身不能判定權利歸屬，但代表眼前價格無法回答保管人的問題。芮記下，買一包實物，和主張控制其後代每一次收成，是兩件不同的事。

paragraphs.en: The company representative warned that samples might deteriorate while people argued. Nara agreed that they needed protection. She asked whether the company would permit the remaining packets to stay sealed under shared observation while the source records were checked. The lawyer consulted his papers, then accepted a short preservation arrangement without withdrawing the claim. Tasa did not shake his hand for the camera. Instead, she asked the other keeper to help count the packets before the table was cleared. Their two cloth labels lay beside the new seals, neither translated into a company name. People who wanted an immediate victory left disappointed. The keepers left with their seeds still present, their names still readable, and time to find the documents a hurried sale would have made easier to ignore.
paragraphs.zh: 公司代表警告，爭論期間樣本可能變質。娜拉同意必須保護它們，便問公司是否願意在查核來源紀錄時，讓剩餘種包保持封存，由雙方共同觀察。律師查閱文件後，接受短期保全，卻沒有撤回主張。塔莎沒有為相機握手，反而請另一位保管人一起在清桌前數清種包。兩人的布標放在新封記旁，沒有被改成公司名字。想立即看見勝利的人失望離開；保管人帶著仍在眼前的種子、仍能閱讀的名字，以及尋找文件的時間離開。倉促出售原本可能讓這些文件更容易被忽略。

paragraphs.en: Two keepers exchanged cloth labels bearing the same plant's different village names. Neither wanted to choose a single name; both wanted future readers to know why there were two.
paragraphs.zh: 兩名保管人交換布標，標上同一植物在不同村落的名稱。她們都不想只選一個名字，而希望後人理解為何有兩個。

paragraphs.en: Evening brought one measurable gain: the company agreed to a short preservation order, not to surrender its claim.
paragraphs.zh: 傍晚帶來一項可量測的進展：公司同意短期保全命令，但沒有放棄主張。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 8?
options: New labels could show both origin and the limits of permission.
A corporation claimed a patent on a strain kept by four villages.
A cooling valve stuck and several treasured trays began to wilt.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「一家公司聲稱擁有四個村落保存品系的專利」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara asked to see the source records before discussing any price.
Nara cleared the room and let the plants go while the team fixed the pipe.
Nara asked villages to approve the wording in their own languages.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉要求先查看來源紀錄，再談價格」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: After sunset, lamps lit a night bazaar built around a roofless observatory.
paragraphs.zh: 日落之後，燈火點亮建於露天觀星臺周圍的夜市。

paragraphs.en: An elderly vendor showed a map of wells absent from the new atlas.
paragraphs.zh: 一名老攤販拿出新版地圖上不存在的水井圖。

paragraphs.en: A woman in the lounge asked for help with her citizenship papers; the new compulsory registry had left her status unclear. Nearby, a vendor reported an assault during a failed bid for a stall. Nara would not let either story distract from the well search, but she refused to dismiss the harm. An ally from the cemetery district offered an old expedition chart marked with a mint-green symbol.
paragraphs.zh: 一名坐在休息室的女子請人協助辦理公民身分文件；新的強制登記使她的身分不明。附近攤販則報告有人在攤位競標失敗後遭到襲擊。娜拉不讓任何一件事分散找井的注意力，卻也拒絕忽視傷害。來自墓園區的盟友拿出一張舊探險圖，上面畫著薄荷綠記號。

paragraphs.en: A rumor linked the wells to a violent raid twenty years before.
paragraphs.zh: 傳言把那些水井與二十年前的一場暴力突襲連在一起。

paragraphs.en: The map's exterior cover showed a galaxy, though the manifest inside listed ordinary goods: dried tuna, rope and tools. The premier had once inspected the route from the rear of a convoy. A thief tried to snatch the chart, then had to squat behind a foul-smelling stall; the stink exposed his hiding place. Nara chose not to embrace the rumor that the premier had stolen water without a single verified measure.
paragraphs.zh: 地圖外封面畫著星河，裡面的貨物清單卻只是日常用品：乾燥鮪魚、繩索與工具。首相曾坐在車隊後方巡視這條路。一名小偷試圖搶走地圖，後來蹲藏在臭味濃烈的攤位後；惡臭暴露了他的藏身處。娜拉決定不接受首相偷水的傳言，因為仍沒有任何驗證過的測量。

paragraphs.en: After the arguments had been heard, Nara checked landmarks on foot instead of repeating the rumor.
paragraphs.zh: 各方意見都說完後，娜拉徒步核對地標，而不是轉述傳言。

paragraphs.en: The vendor held his map beneath a lamp until the old lines showed through the newer ink. A road that ended at the market continued on his sheet toward the sealed wells. Rui asked who had drawn the earlier boundary. He could name the surveyor, but she had died years before. Nara copied the landmarks rather than treating a dead person's reputation as a substitute for checking the ground.
paragraphs.zh: 攤販把地圖舉到燈下，讓舊線條透過較新的墨色顯現。新版道路止於市集，他的圖卻繼續通往封井。芮問舊界線是誰畫的，他說得出測量員姓名，但她多年前已過世。娜拉抄下地標，沒有用亡者聲望取代實地確認。

paragraphs.en: They went first to a broken stair marked near the observatory. Its lowest steps had vanished beneath sand, and a newer wall blocked the route shown on the map. Ilyas measured the corner from a surviving stone marker. The vendor watched from the street while they compared the distance. An old doorway appeared where the drawing predicted, although its wooden frame had been removed. That gave them a second point from which to look for the wells without entering houses or digging through private gardens.
paragraphs.zh: 他們先到觀星臺旁的斷階。最下面幾階被沙埋住，新牆則擋住圖上的路。伊利從尚存的石界標量起，攤販在街邊看他們比對距離。舊門口出現在地圖預示的位置，只是木框已拆。這給了他們第二個定位點，不必闖進住宅或挖私人花園，也能尋找水井。

paragraphs.en: At the first cover, the vendor dropped a small stone through a gap. There was no clear splash. He looked embarrassed and suggested that the map had wasted their evening. Nara asked him to stop before trying a larger stone. A quiet shaft could be dry, blocked, or simply deeper than they could judge by listening. Opening it without equipment would answer none of those questions safely. They marked both covers and recorded who controlled access to the courtyards. Rui left the old raid out of her account because nobody there could connect it to the water below. When the vendor folded his map, Nara asked permission to bring a copy to the water workers. His hand stayed on the paper for a moment. Then he pointed out a path that was wide enough for their equipment, but too narrow for the company's carts.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一個井蓋旁，攤販從縫隙投入小石子，沒有聽見清楚水聲。他尷尬地說，也許地圖浪費了大家一個晚上。娜拉請他別再試更大的石頭。無聲井道可能乾涸、堵住，也可能深得無法靠聽覺判斷。沒有設備就打開，無法安全回答任何一個問題。他們標出兩個井蓋，記下誰管理庭院入口。芮沒有把舊突襲寫進報導，因為現場無人能把它與井水連結。攤販摺圖時，娜拉請求帶副本給水務工人。他的手在紙上停了片刻，接著指出一條足夠讓設備通過、卻容不下公司大車的小路。

paragraphs.en: At sunset, the team could finally state a limited outcome: two covered wells were found, though their water was untested.
paragraphs.zh: 日落時，團隊終於能說出有限成果：眾人找到兩口封住的井，但還未測試水質。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 9?
options: An elderly vendor showed a map of wells absent from the new atlas.
The filtered water passed visual tests but still needed chemical analysis.
A budget amendment could pay for small seed plots without a monopoly.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「一名老攤販拿出新版地圖上不存在的水井圖」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara refused to irrigate edible crops until the remaining tests were complete.
Nara refused a private bargain and read the costs aloud.
Nara checked landmarks on foot instead of repeating the rumor.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉徒步核對地標，而不是轉述傳言」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: Three laboratories brought their equipment to a shared greenhouse.
paragraphs.zh: 三間實驗室把設備帶到共同溫室。

paragraphs.en: Identical seeds responded differently to salt and soil organisms.
paragraphs.zh: 相同種子對鹽分與土壤生物產生不同反應。

paragraphs.en: A clinic director warned that public talk about abortion could betray anonymous patients. A bronze sign outside the dome offered privacy, but an arrogant merchant tried to enter with a camera. Nara told him that credibility depended on respecting people, including the local butcher and every entrepreneur who paid to keep the clinic open. Their medical records had no place in the seed test.
paragraphs.zh: 診所主任提醒，公開談論墮胎可能洩露匿名病人的身分。圓頂屋外的青銅招牌承諾保護隱私，一名傲慢商人卻拿著相機想闖入。娜拉告訴他，可信度建立在尊重每個人之上，包括當地肉商與出資維持診所的創業者。他們的醫療紀錄不應出現在種子實驗裡。

paragraphs.en: The minister wanted one perfect headline before the council vote.
paragraphs.zh: 部長希望在議會表決前有個完美頭條。

paragraphs.en: The laboratories compared the seeds' genetics, while a technician explained how a test could identify a particular molecule in the soil. An initiative to integrate their data was more reliable than a ridiculous claim that one sector alone could sustain the whole basin. A researcher agreed to testify about a vertical growing chamber and the insects trapped in it. Outside, wildlife moved along a fence, indifferent to speeches but dependent on the water the scientists discussed. One family risked losing its home when its mortgage payment came due.
paragraphs.zh: 實驗室比較種子的遺傳特性，一名技術員則解釋測試如何辨認土壤中特定的分子。整合資料的倡議，比荒唐地聲稱單一產業就能支撐整個盆地更可靠。一名研究者同意作證，說明垂直栽培艙與困在其中的昆蟲。外頭的野生動物沿柵欄移動，不在乎演說，卻依賴科學家正在討論的水。 有個家庭在房貸到期時面臨失去住處的風險。

paragraphs.en: Instead of offering a broad promise, Nara published the failed trays and the measurement uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉公布失敗的培養盤與測量不確定性。

paragraphs.en: Each laboratory had brought its own preferred tray. One held water longer, one drained quickly, and the third had labels pasted over old marks. Before comparing results, Ilyas asked the technicians to explain those differences. A visitor complained that they had already waited long enough for an answer. Nara moved a chair toward the worktable and invited him to watch the preparations rather than wait for a speech.
paragraphs.zh: 三間實驗室各帶慣用培養盤，一種保水較久，一種排水快，第三種的新標籤蓋住舊字。比較結果前，伊利請技術員說明差異。一名訪客抱怨大家為答案等得夠久了。娜拉把椅子移到工作桌旁，邀他看準備過程，不必坐等演說。

paragraphs.en: The technicians agreed to record the starting conditions beside every tray. That did not make the equipment identical, but it made the differences visible. Rui read out one label incorrectly, confusing the amount of salt with the number of seeds. A technician corrected her before the figure entered her notes. At the far end of the table, the visitor began checking the labels himself. He found a tray whose watering time had not been written down. Its promising roots could remain on display, but they could not fairly be compared with the others as though nothing were missing.
paragraphs.zh: 技術員同意在每盤旁記下起始條件。設備並未因此相同，但差異變得看得見。芮一度把鹽量念成種子數，一名技術員在數字寫進筆記前更正她。桌子另一端，訪客開始自行檢查標籤，找到一盤未寫澆水時間。它有希望的根仍可展示，卻不能假裝資料完整，與其他盤公平比較。

paragraphs.en: The ministry's messenger returned to ask which tray should appear behind the minister during his address. Nara pointed to the full row, including the failures. He said the wall was too narrow. She suggested moving the address somewhere else. After he left, Ilyas examined the failed tray again, turning its label toward the light. A brown patch near one corner might explain something, or might be an unrelated mark. He asked the technician to keep it rather than wash it away. The visitor who had wanted a quick answer stayed to help carry the trays indoors. He now knew enough to ask why the laboratories disagreed. That was a harder question for the demonstration to answer, but it belonged to the results they actually had. The technician marked the unrecorded watering time as unknown, not zero. An empty field and a measured absence were different observations. The visitor copied that distinction onto his own page before helping with the trays.
paragraphs.zh: 部門信使回來問，部長致詞時該在身後放哪一盤。娜拉指向整排，包括失敗的。他說牆不夠寬，她建議換個地方致詞。信使走後，伊利再查看失敗培養盤，把標籤轉向光線。角落褐斑可能提供解釋，也可能毫不相關，他請技術員保留，不要洗掉。原本想要快速答案的訪客留下幫忙把盤搬進室內。如今他已能問，為何三間實驗室意見不同。這是示範更難回答的問題，卻屬於他們真正取得的結果。 技術員把未記錄的澆水時間標成未知，而非零。資料空缺與量到沒有發生，是不同觀察。訪客搬盤前，也在自己的紙上記下這個區別。

paragraphs.en: By the time the shadows lengthened, the experiment proved limited germination, not a drought-proof harvest.
paragraphs.zh: 影子拉長時，實驗只證明在有限條件下能發芽，並非保證耐旱收成。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 10?
options: The broken valve contained metal unlike the approved design.
The new charter required consent, return records and shared training.
Identical seeds responded differently to salt and soil organisms.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「相同種子對鹽分與土壤生物產生不同反應」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Tasa insisted that a living seed was a responsibility rather than a trophy.
Nara published the failed trays and the measurement uncertainty.
Ilyas compared the maker's marks with purchase and repair records.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉公布失敗的培養盤與測量不確定性」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: That morning, a remote nursery counted its remaining cups of fresh water.
paragraphs.zh: 那天早上，偏遠育苗站一杯杯計算剩餘的淡水。

paragraphs.en: A newly planted tray would need more water than the schedule allowed.
paragraphs.zh: 新種的培養盤需要的水超過供水表允許的量。

paragraphs.en: The cold-night trial might accelerate germination, but even a compliment from the minister could not replace a tested component. Ilyas planned to deploy a minimal crew as fatigue spread through the nursery. Its grim walls belonged to an old institution that had once claimed to be neutral. Nara prepared a petition for independent supervision, then watched a seed leaf quiver in the lamp light.
paragraphs.zh: 夜間低溫試驗或許能加快發芽，但部長的稱讚無法取代測試過的零件。疲勞在育苗站蔓延，伊利計畫只派最少人力。陰暗牆壁屬於一個曾宣稱中立的老機構。娜拉準備請願書，要求獨立監督，再看著一片種葉在燈下微微顫動。

paragraphs.en: The ministry urged an accelerated launch to calm investors.
paragraphs.zh: 部門催促加快啟動，藉此安撫投資者。

paragraphs.en: The realm of plant science was full of recommendation and doubt. A veteran grower called the new soil mixture his specialty, but refused to stake all the surviving seed on one tray. A specimen could thrive or fail for reasons that seemed trivial. Everyone would undergo the same training before taking samples, so that a beautiful result would not hide a mistake in procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 植物科學領域充滿建議與疑問。一名資深農友說新的土壤配方是自己的專長，卻拒絕把所有倖存種子押在一盤上。一個樣本可能因看似微不足道的原因長好或失敗。所有人在採樣前都必須接受相同訓練，以免漂亮結果掩蓋程序錯誤。

paragraphs.en: Nara limited the next trial to twelve cells and requested public counters.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉把下一次試驗限縮為十二格，並要求公開計量。

paragraphs.en: The nursery assistant had divided the watering schedule into neat rows, but none of them showed the hours when nearby households filled their containers. Nara asked the girl with the tea kettle to bring her mother to the gate. They arrived carrying the empty vessel between them. The mother did not object to the seedlings. She wanted to know why the nursery could announce a new trial before anyone had explained its share of the well.
paragraphs.zh: 育苗站助理把澆水表分成整齊行列，卻沒有一行顯示鄰居何時裝家用水。娜拉請拿茶壺的女孩帶母親到門口。母女抬著空壺前來。母親並非反對幼苗，而是想知道，為什麼還沒說明育苗站能分多少井水，就能宣布新試驗。

paragraphs.en: Ilyas set a meter at the nursery inlet and invited her to watch the reading. The twelve cells would receive the measured amount already allowed for testing. Enlarging the trial would require another discussion, not a quiet adjustment while the neighbors slept. The assistant worried that a smaller trial would make the report look weak. Nara asked her to write the question the twelve cells could actually answer. After two attempts, she described a comparison between soils rather than a promise to supply the city with grain.
paragraphs.zh: 伊利在入水口裝錶，邀她看讀數。十二格使用既有測試配額內的水，擴大試驗就得再討論，不能趁鄰居睡覺偷偷調整。助理擔心試驗太小，報告不好看。娜拉請她寫下十二格實際能回答的問題。修改兩次後，她寫的是土壤比較，而非承諾替全城供應穀物。

paragraphs.en: The ministry's visitor looked disappointed when he saw the empty spaces on the bench. He offered to send more trays without charge. Nara thanked him and asked who would supply their water. He had no answer. The assistant moved the unused trays into storage herself, leaving the meter where visitors could see it. At the gate, the girl tipped her kettle to show how little it held. Nara did not fill it from the trial allowance and pretend the dispute was solved. She walked with the family to the public tap, where the mother checked the day's household supply. The nursery could continue its limited work without taking that water. Whether twelve cells would be useful enough remained a question for the results, not for the empty spaces a visitor wished to fill.
paragraphs.zh: 部門訪客看見桌上的空位，露出失望，願意免費送更多培養盤。娜拉謝過，並問誰供應用水，他無法回答。助理自己把未用的盤收進庫房，把水錶留在訪客看得到的位置。門口，女孩傾斜茶壺，讓她看見壺有多小。娜拉沒有從試驗配額裝水，假裝爭議已解決，而是陪母女走到公共水龍頭，讓母親確認當天家用水。育苗站可以在不取用那份水的情況下繼續有限工作。十二格究竟夠不夠有用，必須看結果，而不是看訪客想填滿的空位。

paragraphs.en: A girl asked whether the nursery's single cup of water would be taken from her family's kettle. Nara showed the separate meter before asking the girl to believe any promise.
paragraphs.zh: 一名女孩問育苗站的一杯水會不會從她家的茶壺扣除。娜拉先展示獨立水錶，才請女孩考慮相信承諾。

paragraphs.en: Evening brought one measurable gain: the nursery conserved enough water for its neighbors.
paragraphs.zh: 傍晚帶來一項可量測的進展：育苗站因此保住了鄰居所需的水。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 11?
options: The state had stored its last private seed agreement in a locked cabinet.
A newly planted tray would need more water than the schedule allowed.
Each community wanted a different limit on seed sharing.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「新種的培養盤需要的水超過供水表允許的量」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara limited the next trial to twelve cells and requested public counters.
Nara proposed a cooperative with an explicit right to withdraw.
Nara required a public release after personal data were protected.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉把下一次試驗限縮為十二格，並要求公開計量」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: By the time the sun reached the eastern ridge, Tasa led Nara to a shaded room below the old archive.
paragraphs.zh: 太陽升到東方山脊時，塔莎帶娜拉進入舊檔案庫底下的陰涼房間。

paragraphs.en: The seed-sharing page lacked signatures that the village book remembered.
paragraphs.zh: 種子共享頁面缺少村簿記載過的簽名。

paragraphs.en: A strange mark in the old register seemed abnormal. Nara asked Tasa to acquaint her with the village names, while Ilyas checked the bolt on its cabinet. The date was compatible with an earlier transfer but not with the official story. Nara decided to confront the discrepancy before the continental seed board. No one would be held hostage by an accusation, and no one could kidnap a keeper's testimony for private use.
paragraphs.zh: 舊登記簿上一道奇怪記號似乎不正常。娜拉請塔莎介紹村落姓名，伊利則檢查櫃子的螺栓。日期與更早的移轉相符，卻與官方說法不合。娜拉決定在大陸種子委員會前直面矛盾。沒有人應因指控而成為人質，也沒有人可以劫走保管人的證詞供私人使用。

paragraphs.en: A government agent called the missing names a clerical mistake.
paragraphs.zh: 政府代表把失蹤名字稱為文書疏失。

paragraphs.en: A missionary had once copied the original script. Rui could only mumble its unfamiliar dialect, so Tasa asked a village reader to help. The village norm required a second observer who could read it aloud. As a viewer of these records, Nara felt a sensation of shame: an old contract mentioned slavery and called an entire stock of seeds a gift. Tasa rejected the term traitor for any elder who had signed under pressure. The village's memory remained viable even when the paper was not. Tasa called the missing names a form of discrimination, not a harmless omission.
paragraphs.zh: 一名傳教士曾抄下原始文書。芮只能含糊念出不熟悉的方言，塔莎便請一名村中讀者協助。村落規範要求第二名能朗讀的觀察者。娜拉看著這些紀錄，感到一陣羞愧：舊合約提到奴隸制度，還把整批種子當成禮物。塔莎拒絕把任何在壓力下簽字的長者稱為叛徒。即使紙張腐朽，村落記憶仍然有生命力。 塔莎說，失蹤的名字是一種歧視，而不是無傷大雅的疏漏。

paragraphs.en: After the arguments had been heard, Nara copied both registers without declaring either one genuine.
paragraphs.zh: 各方意見都說完後，娜拉抄下兩份紀錄，沒有先宣稱哪份是真的。

paragraphs.en: Tasa knew where her sister's name should have stood because she remembered the table on which the village book had been signed. One leg was shorter than the others. Her sister had steadied it with a folded scrap while the witnesses wrote. The government representative smiled politely and called that a touching memory. Nara asked him to wait. A memory could not replace a signature, but it could help them find the people and objects connected with it.
paragraphs.zh: 塔莎知道姊妹名字應在何處，因為她記得簽村簿的那張桌子，有一條腿比較短。當時姊妹用摺紙墊穩，見證人才落筆。政府代表禮貌微笑，稱這是動人回憶。娜拉請他等等。記憶不能代替簽名，卻能協助尋找相關的人與物。

paragraphs.en: The archivist brought the village volume from a separate shelf. Its page recorded witnesses beside the seed transfer; the government copy listed only a shipment. Ilyas placed weights on the corners so the fragile paper would remain flat. Rui photographed the whole page before taking details. Tasa did not want her sister's address printed. They made a working copy with that line covered, preserving the full original for the people authorized to inspect it.
paragraphs.zh: 檔案員從另一架拿來村簿。村簿在種子移轉旁列出見證人，政府副本卻只列運送。伊利用鎮紙壓平脆弱紙角。芮先拍全頁，再拍細節。塔莎不希望姊妹住址刊出，他們便遮住那一行製作工作副本，完整原件仍留供獲准者查閱。

paragraphs.en: The representative suggested filling the blank from the village volume. That would make the two copies agree, he said. Nara refused to write a new signature where an original was missing. First they needed to establish which document had been copied from which, and what permission each was meant to record. The archivist checked the shelf register for a witness book removed during the drought. It named a receiving office, but not a return date. Tasa recognized the office's old location. She had passed it on the way to visit her sister. When they left the cool room, she carried no restored signature and no promise that every record would be recovered. She carried the address of the next place to look, written on paper she could read without asking a government official to explain it.
paragraphs.zh: 代表提議按村簿補上空白，說這樣兩份就一致了。娜拉拒絕在原簽名缺失處新添簽名。必須先釐清哪份抄自哪份、各自記錄何種許可。檔案員查找乾旱期間移出的見證簿，架位登記列了收件辦公室，卻沒有歸還日期。塔莎認得那個辦公室舊址，從前探望姊妹會經過。離開陰涼房間時，她沒有帶回簽名，也沒有得到所有紀錄都能找回的保證。她帶著下一個尋找地點的地址，寫在自己能閱讀、不必求官員解釋的紙上。

paragraphs.en: In the archive's cool shadow, Tasa touched the place where her sister's name should have been. She did not cry; she asked Nara to leave enough space to write it correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 檔案室的涼蔭裡，塔莎碰了碰本應寫著姊妹名字的地方。她沒有哭，只請娜拉留足空間，好把名字寫對。

paragraphs.en: At sunset, the team could finally state a limited outcome: the original transfer required an independent witness to be valid.
paragraphs.zh: 日落時，團隊終於能說出有限成果：原始移轉必須有獨立見證人才有效。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 12?
options: The seed-sharing page lacked signatures that the village book remembered.
A sudden wind buried the route markers and overturned a cart.
The cooperative still had only thirteen young plants and many unanswered questions.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「種子共享頁面缺少村簿記載過的簽名」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara sent the search party to the driver and marked the crates for later recovery.
Nara offered a three-season plan, open records and the right for villages to refuse.
Nara copied both registers without declaring either one genuine.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉抄下兩份紀錄，沒有先宣稱哪份是真的」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: The caravan followed a buried root channel to an abandoned terrace.
paragraphs.zh: 車隊沿著埋藏的根道前往廢棄梯田。

paragraphs.en: Farmers had documented decades of careful seed selection there.
paragraphs.zh: 農友曾在當地記下數十年的細心選種。

paragraphs.en: The keepers wanted acknowledgement, not astonishment, when they described their work. One grower was allergic to the dust used in the old storage jars. Nara asked for consent before testing a conversion to safer containers, and she took a considerate approach to families with limited space. A water deficit could make any extension dangerous; hence each proposed format had to be measured, not merely admired.
paragraphs.zh: 保管人描述工作時希望得到承認，而不是驚訝。一名農友對舊儲存罐的粉塵過敏。娜拉先徵求同意，才測試改用更安全的容器；她也體貼空間有限的家庭。缺水可能使任何擴張都變得危險，因此每一種新格式都必須測量，而不只是令人讚嘆。

paragraphs.en: The corporation treated communal knowledge as an abandoned asset.
paragraphs.zh: 公司把共同知識視為無主資產。

paragraphs.en: Only a legitimate keeper could authorize a seed transfer. Nara put a lump of dried clay beside a mattress to demonstrate how old seals cracked. A street performer offered to stage a celebration, but Tasa's pessimism made her demand a precaution first. Even sober officials had a preference for impressive speeches. Nara refused to utilize a patient's rare syndrome as emotional evidence for the seed campaign.
paragraphs.zh: 只有合法保管人能授權移轉種子。娜拉把一團乾泥放在床墊旁，示範舊封泥如何裂開。一位街頭藝人提議舉行慶祝，塔莎卻很悲觀，要求先採取預防措施。即使清醒理智的官員也偏愛動聽演說。娜拉拒絕利用病人的罕見症候群作為種子運動的煽情證據。

paragraphs.en: Instead of offering a broad promise, Nara asked each keeper whether the old consent extended to commercial breeding.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉逐一詢問保管者，舊同意是否包含商業育種。

paragraphs.en: The farmer laid the dried root across Nara's open notebook. He could not remember which year his father had first selected the strain, but he could show her the narrow terrace where it had grown. A company visitor asked what an old root could prove. Nara answered that it could guide an inspection. It could not, by itself, sign away a family's knowledge or establish the company's claim.
paragraphs.zh: 農夫把乾根橫放在娜拉的筆記本上。他想不起父親哪年開始選這品系，卻能帶她看種植的窄梯田。公司訪客問老根能證明什麼。娜拉說，它能引導實地查訪，卻不能單獨讓出家族知識，也不能證明公司的主張。

paragraphs.en: They followed the farmer between collapsed walls. He stopped at a stone channel and described how his family had kept seed from the plants nearest its dry end. Over many seasons, their choices had become part of what the company now called its own improvement. Ilyas sketched the channel while Tasa asked which neighboring families had exchanged seed with them. The farmer named two, then hesitated over a third. He did not want to answer for a household that was absent. Nara left a space rather than putting the most likely name into it.
paragraphs.zh: 他們跟農夫走過倒塌石牆。他在石渠前停下，說家人如何從最乾那端的植株留種。多年選擇逐漸成了公司如今宣稱獨有的改良。伊利畫水渠，塔莎問哪些鄰居交換過種子。農夫說出兩家，第三家卻猶豫了。他不想替缺席家庭回答。娜拉留下空格，沒有填入最可能的名字。

paragraphs.en: Back at the caravan, she read the proposed permission aloud. Several keepers accepted public research if the results came back to their villages. They refused a clause allowing one buyer to prevent everyone else from breeding the next crop. The visitor warned that separating those permissions would make investment harder. The farmer picked up his root and said that making things easy for a buyer was not the reason his father had kept selecting plants. Nara changed the form so each choice could be marked separately. No single signature would now pretend to mean three different things. Before leaving, the farmer asked for a copy for the absent household. He wanted them to hear the actual choices, not merely that their neighbors had agreed to something at a meeting beside the road. At the caravan door, the visitor asked whether he could take the dried root. The farmer refused and wrapped it in his own cloth. Permission to describe a history had not included permission to carry away the object that had helped reveal it.
paragraphs.zh: 回到車隊，她朗讀提議的許可。幾名保管人接受公開研究，條件是結果必須回到村子；他們拒絕讓單一買家阻止其他人培育下一代的條款。訪客警告，分開許可會增加投資困難。農夫拿起乾根，說父親持續選種，不是為了方便買家。娜拉修改表格，讓每項選擇能分開勾選，一個簽名不再假裝同時代表三種意思。離開前，農夫索取副本給缺席家庭。他希望他們聽見真正的選項，而不只是聽說鄰居在路邊會議同意了某件事。 車隊門口，訪客問能否帶走乾根。農夫拒絕，用自己的布包起。允許描述一段歷史，並不包含帶走協助揭示歷史之物的許可。

paragraphs.en: By the time the shadows lengthened, most allowed open research but refused exclusive sales.
paragraphs.zh: 影子拉長時，多數人同意公開研究，但拒絕獨家販售。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 13?
options: Thirteen seedlings emerged in a measured row after ten days.
A crate marked four hundred contained only twenty-eight living seeds.
Farmers had documented decades of careful seed selection there.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「農友曾在當地記下數十年的細心選種」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara copied the seals and separated broken packets from intact ones.
Nara asked each keeper whether the old consent extended to commercial breeding.
Nara counted surviving leaves and posted the next month's water needs.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉逐一詢問保管者，舊同意是否包含商業育種」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: That morning, the capital convened an extraordinary water council.
paragraphs.zh: 那天早上，首都召開特別水務議會。

paragraphs.en: A proposed monopoly paired seed access with private water contracts.
paragraphs.zh: 壟斷提案把種子取得權與私人用水合約綁在一起。

paragraphs.en: An advocate from the athletics field challenged a clause in the proposed water monopoly. One councilor called the plan communist, another demanded compromise, and a customs officer described the evolution of older trade rules. Nara argued that no company should exploit the crisis or exceed its authority. The debate drew a glare from the minister, who preferred to indulge his own supporters.
paragraphs.zh: 一名來自運動場的倡議者質疑水務壟斷提案中的一項條款。一名議員把計畫稱為共產主義，另一人要求妥協，海關官員則說明舊貿易規則如何演變。娜拉主張任何公司都不該利用危機或逾越權力。這場辯論引來部長怒視，他更喜歡縱容自己的支持者。

paragraphs.en: The minister claimed delay would condemn the city to hunger.
paragraphs.zh: 部長宣稱拖延會讓全城陷入飢餓。

paragraphs.en: The minister promised infinite growth while his engineers asked for laser measurements and practical maintenance. A pickup brought replacement pipes; half were already damaged, a partly useful gift. Nara called the contradiction pathetic, though she kept her rhetoric plain. She had sentimental reasons to defend the seed library, but those reasons did not excuse poor planning or erase the need for another vote.
paragraphs.zh: 部長承諾無限成長，工程師卻要求雷射測量與實際維護。一輛小貨車運來替換管線，其中一半已受損，是份只有部分用途的禮物。娜拉認為這矛盾很可悲，卻仍保持平實措辭。她因感情而想捍衛種子庫，但感情不能為糟糕規劃開脫，也不能取代下一次表決。

paragraphs.en: Nara presented the limits of the experiments without offering political slogans.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉陳述試驗限制，沒有提出政治口號。

paragraphs.en: The council screen showed one large saving beside the proposed contract. Ilyas could not find the cost of maintaining the household taps beneath it. An official said the details were in an attachment. Rui asked for the attachment to be displayed. A pause spread through the hall while someone searched for the correct file. The people who had been asked to judge the total had not been given the same pages as the people presenting it.
paragraphs.zh: 議會螢幕在合約旁顯示一大筆節省額，伊利卻找不到家用水龍頭的維護費。官員說細節在附件。芮要求展示附件，廳內一陣停頓，有人搜尋正確檔案。被要求判斷總額的人，拿到的頁面竟與簡報者不同。

paragraphs.en: When the file appeared, Nara traced the link between seed access and a long water commitment. A household could not accept one without accepting the other. The minister asked whether she preferred that seedlings die while every clause was debated. She pointed to the current trial, which already had a limited supply. Continuing that trial was a different decision from placing every future planting under the same private arrangement. Tasa stood beside a model tap and explained how a family would collect water under each proposal. The difference was easier to follow when the officials had to name who could turn the handle.
paragraphs.zh: 檔案出現後，娜拉指出種子取得權如何綁定長期用水承諾，家庭無法只接受其中一項。部長問，她是否寧願讓幼苗在逐條辯論中死去。她指出現有試驗已獲有限供水。繼續該試驗，與把未來每次播種放進同一私人安排，是不同決定。塔莎站在水龍頭模型旁，說明各方案下家庭如何取水。官員必須說出誰能轉動把手時，差異就容易理解了。

paragraphs.en: The chair called a short recess. Rui showed Nara a headline that made the hearing sound like a final defeat for the company. Nara asked her to keep listening. The restriction under discussion was temporary, and the second vote still mattered. Outside, village delegates compared travel times and argued about who could return before the deadline. One could not leave her well unattended for another full day. They arranged to exchange the next set of papers through the clinic cart rather than expect every keeper to travel to the capital. When the council resumed, their plan was still fragile, but it no longer depended on the minister being the only person able to circulate a document quickly.
paragraphs.zh: 主席宣布短暫休會。芮拿標題給娜拉看，彷彿公司已徹底敗北。娜拉請她繼續聽，目前討論的只是暫時限制，第二次表決仍重要。廳外村代表比較交通時間，爭論誰能在期限前再來。有一位無法再離開水井整天。他們安排透過診所運貨車交換下一批文件，不再期待每名保管人都前往首都。重新開會時，計畫仍脆弱，但已不必依靠部長成為唯一能快速傳送文件的人。

paragraphs.en: Outside the council chamber, Rui let a headline she had loved fall into the recycling box. It had sounded brave, she admitted, but it had made three frightened villages seem like one voice.
paragraphs.zh: 議事廳外，芮把自己很喜歡的標題丟進回收箱。她承認它讀來勇敢，卻把三個害怕的村子寫得像只有一種聲音。

paragraphs.en: Evening brought one measurable gain: the council passed a temporary restriction and scheduled a second vote.
paragraphs.zh: 傍晚帶來一項可量測的進展：議會通過臨時限制，並排定第二次表決。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 14?
options: Elder Tasa knew a buried variety survived in salty ground.
A proposed monopoly paired seed access with private water contracts.
New labels could show both origin and the limits of permission.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「壟斷提案把種子取得權與私人用水合約綁在一起」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara presented the limits of the experiments without offering political slogans.
Nara asked villages to approve the wording in their own languages.
Nara requested permission for three small soil jars.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉陳述試驗限制，沒有提出政治口號」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: By the time the sun reached the eastern ridge, unexpected heat swept through the city nurseries.
paragraphs.zh: 太陽升到東方山脊時，異常熱浪席捲城市育苗站。

paragraphs.en: A cooling valve stuck and several treasured trays began to wilt.
paragraphs.zh: 冷卻閥卡住，幾盤珍貴幼苗開始萎縮。

paragraphs.en: The ballot on expanding the greenhouse had been set aside; the boom from the failed cooling equipment had sent workers running, leaving their belongings behind. A chef brought soup to the repair crew, and a nurse explained the complexity of heat injuries. Three consecutive alarms had left a technician unable to stand; no one should cripple the rescue by asking for a diagnosis in front of strangers. Nara asked for a private medical room and a public account of the damaged ecology.
paragraphs.zh: 擴建溫室的選票已擱置；冷卻設備故障的巨響使工人丟下隨身物品，紛紛奔逃。一名廚師替維修隊送來湯，護士則解釋熱傷害的複雜性。連續三次警報使一名技術員站不起來；不應因要求在陌生人面前診斷而妨礙救援。娜拉要求設置私密醫療室，並公開記錄受損的生態。

paragraphs.en: A director demanded that the rare seedlings be saved before the workers.
paragraphs.zh: 主任要求先救珍稀幼苗再救工人。

paragraphs.en: A foul smell rose from the broken cooling line. Some officials were indifferent; others likewise wanted to hear nothing but good news. A worker gave a low moan while a doctor checked him, and Nara called for proper supervision. The resort owner offered sponsorship and shelter, but demanded sovereignty over the nursery's future harvest. Nara said the offer was straightforward: helpful today, dangerous tomorrow, a strand of security tied to control. The nurse could diagnose the injury only after speaking with the patient in private. Public sentiment favored saving seedlings, but injured workers needed care first.
paragraphs.zh: 破裂冷卻管散出惡臭。有些官員漠不關心，其他人同樣只想聽好消息。一名工人呻吟，醫師替他檢查，娜拉則要求適當監督。度假村老闆提供贊助與住宿，卻要求掌控育苗站未來收成的主權。娜拉說提議很直接：今天有幫助，明天卻危險；那根安全繩索綁著的其實是控制權。 護士必須私下詢問病患後，才能診斷傷勢。 民意傾向搶救幼苗，但受傷工人需要先得到照顧。

paragraphs.en: After the arguments had been heard, Nara cleared the room and let the plants go while the team fixed the pipe.
paragraphs.zh: 各方意見都說完後，娜拉疏散房間，讓植物承受損失，團隊則修復管線。

paragraphs.en: The first worker came out holding a tray against his chest. He would not put it down until Nara pointed to the others still inside. Ilyas needed both hands free to move him away from the door. The worker set the tray on the ground, then tried to go back for a colleague. Nara kept the doorway clear while the repair crew brought the exhausted man out. Nobody was allowed to return for a favorite plant.
paragraphs.zh: 第一名工人把培養盤抱在胸前走出，直到娜拉指向仍在裡面的人，他才肯放下。伊利需要他空出雙手，才能把他移離門口。工人放下盤，又想回去找同伴。娜拉保持門道暢通，維修隊把筋疲力竭的男子抬出。沒有人能為心愛的植物重新進去。

paragraphs.en: Outside, the nursery director counted the damaged trays before asking about the workers. Tasa interrupted him with a list of the people who had entered the room. Two names had not yet been checked. The nurse found both men beside the service entrance and asked the others to stop moving them from place to place. Only when every person was accounted for did Ilyas approach the cooling line. He isolated the equipment while a second worker watched the controls. Hurrying into the same heat would not make the first failure less costly.
paragraphs.zh: 室外，主任先數損壞的盤，才問工人。塔莎拿著入室名單打斷他，仍有兩個名字未核對。護士在側邊出入口找到兩人，請大家別再讓他們移來移去。確定全員到齊後，伊利才接近冷卻管線。他隔離設備，另一名工人看守控制器。匆忙衝回同樣高溫，不能降低先前故障的代價。

paragraphs.en: By the time they could inspect the plants, half the new seedlings were beyond recovery. The worker who had carried out the first tray apologized as if he had chosen which ones would die. Nara asked him to sit with the nurse. The decision to leave the room had been hers, and she would record it that way. Rui photographed the damaged area without taking pictures of people receiving care. The director wanted to announce a rapid reopening. Ilyas placed the failed valve on a cloth and refused to give a date until he knew why it had jammed. Nara stayed to help count what remained. A smaller total was painful to write, but it was not a reason to send anyone back through an unsafe door.
paragraphs.zh: 能檢查植物時，一半新苗已無法挽回。最早抱盤出來的工人道歉，彷彿是他選擇讓哪些苗死去。娜拉請他坐在護士旁，撤離決定是她下的，紀錄也會如此寫。芮拍攝受損區，沒有拍接受照護的人。主任想宣布迅速重開，伊利卻把壞閥門放在布上，表示不知道它為何卡住前，不能承諾日期。娜拉留下清點殘存幼苗。較小的總數寫下去很痛苦，但不足以成為把任何人送回危險門內的理由。

paragraphs.en: At sunset, the team could finally state a limited outcome: everyone survived, but half the new seedlings were lost.
paragraphs.zh: 日落時，團隊終於能說出有限成果：所有人都活了下來，但新苗損失了一半。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 15?
options: A cooling valve stuck and several treasured trays began to wilt.
A budget amendment could pay for small seed plots without a monopoly.
Two of three planted pots showed a pale root after a measured watering.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「冷卻閥卡住，幾盤珍貴幼苗開始萎縮」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara refused a private bargain and read the costs aloud.
Nara posted the water amounts and labeled the failed pot as prominently as the others.
Nara cleared the room and let the plants go while the team fixed the pipe.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉疏散房間，讓植物承受損失，團隊則修復管線」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: Engineer Ilyas opened the recycling station for community inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 工程師伊利開放回收水站供社區檢查。

paragraphs.en: The filtered water passed visual tests but still needed chemical analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 過濾後的水通過外觀檢查，卻仍需化學分析。

paragraphs.en: The town offered accommodation for displaced families, but compassion alone could not clean water that might contaminate crops. Nara pointed out a contradiction in the inspection sheet: debris had been excluded from the sample even though the filter was broken. An exceptional result would justify another test, not a rushed installation. She urged the committee to include every participant in the investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 鎮上提供住宿給撤離家庭，但光靠同情不能清除可能污染作物的水。娜拉指出檢查表上的矛盾：過濾器明明壞了，樣本卻排除了碎屑。異常優良的結果應該促使重做測試，而不是倉促安裝。她敦促委員會讓每位參與者都能投入調查。

paragraphs.en: A trader offered to sell an untested shortcut at double the price.
paragraphs.zh: 商人提出以兩倍價格販售未經測試的捷徑。

paragraphs.en: The franchise owner spoke of integration and an urgent nomination for a new director. Ilyas asked for a pledge that no one would treat clean water as a sacred privilege. A faulty server could trigger a vicious chain of errors; thereby, the field team still needed written backups and a manual valve. Nara refused to approve the system until independent testing was complete. Nara would not exclude households beyond the city wall from the safety tests. Calling the shortcut insane was easier than measuring its actual danger.
paragraphs.zh: 加盟業者談到整合，還急著提名新主任。伊利要求承諾，不讓任何人把乾淨水當作神聖特權。故障伺服器可能引發惡性連鎖錯誤，因此現場隊伍仍需要紙本備份與手動閥門。娜拉拒絕在獨立測試完成前核准系統。 娜拉不會把城牆外的家庭排除在安全測試之外。 把捷徑罵作瘋狂，比實際測量危險來得容易。

paragraphs.en: Instead of offering a broad promise, Nara refused to irrigate edible crops until the remaining tests were complete.
paragraphs.zh: 娜拉拒絕在剩餘檢測完成前用該水灌溉食用作物。

paragraphs.en: Ilyas had polished the viewing glass so thoroughly that the water looked almost invisible. A merchant held an empty bottle beneath it and asked what else anyone could reasonably want. Nara asked where the laboratory sample had been taken. The worker pointed to a tap before the final storage tank. They had not yet sampled the water after it passed through the old connecting pipe.
paragraphs.zh: 伊利把觀察玻璃擦得透亮，水幾乎像不存在。商人拿空瓶放在下面，問大家究竟還想要什麼。娜拉詢問實驗室樣本在哪取的，工人指向最後儲水槽之前的水龍頭。他們還沒取過經過舊連接管之後的水。

paragraphs.en: The merchant said repeating the process would waste a day. Ilyas took his hand off the valve. He had built part of this system and wanted it to work more than most people in the room. That made the missing test harder to admit, not less necessary. He asked the worker to prepare a second sealed container at the outlet. Rui wrote down the two sampling locations so a future reader would not mistake one result for a complete description of the station. Nara placed the labels where the people waiting outside could see which report was still absent.
paragraphs.zh: 商人說重做會浪費一天。伊利把手從閥門移開。他建造了系統的一部分，比在場多數人更希望它成功，因此承認漏測更難，卻不代表可以省略。他請工人在出水口準備第二只封存容器。芮記下兩個採樣位置，避免日後讀者把一項結果誤認成整座水站的完整描述。娜拉把標籤放在外頭等候者看得到的位置，指出哪份報告仍缺席。

paragraphs.en: A grower arrived with empty irrigation jars. His seedlings were small enough that another missed watering might kill them. Nara walked him through the available household and trial allocations rather than offering the untested water as a secret favor. None of the choices was easy. He could keep the smallest planned trial within its existing supply, or ask the keepers to reconsider the schedule openly. He chose to return with the schedule. After he left, Ilyas set the clear glass beside the unopened report and turned off the display lamp. Without the light behind it, the water looked ordinary again. He said he had mistaken being able to see through something for knowing what was inside. The next sample would have to travel through the same pipe as the water people intended to use.
paragraphs.zh: 一名農友帶空灌溉罐前來。他的幼苗很小，再少澆一次水可能就死了。娜拉陪他查看現有家用與試驗配額，沒有私下送未驗水當人情。選擇都不輕鬆。他可以用原供水維持最小試驗，或請保管人公開重議時程。他選擇帶著時程表回來。人走後，伊利把清水杯放在未開封報告旁，關掉展示燈。少了背後照明，水又顯得平常。他說，自己把看得穿誤當成知道裡面有什麼。下一份樣本必須經過人們真正打算使用的同一條管線。

paragraphs.en: Ilyas put a cup of clear recycled water beside an unopened laboratory report. He told the crowd the cup was not yet a guarantee, and nobody tried to drink it.
paragraphs.zh: 伊利把一杯清澈的回收水放在尚未拆封的實驗報告旁。他告訴人群，這杯水還不能代表安全，於是沒有人試喝。

paragraphs.en: By the time the shadows lengthened, the delay prevented a possible contamination event.
paragraphs.zh: 影子拉長時，這次延後避開了可能的污染事件。

questions.question: What did the team discover in Chapter 16?
options: The new charter required consent, return records and shared training.
The clinic and seed carriers shared the last usable shelter.
The filtered water passed visual tests but still needed chemical analysis.
questions.explanation: 本章發現「過濾後的水通過外觀檢查，卻仍需化學分析」，並在後續討論中確認了這個觀察，其他選項是不同事件。

questions.question: Which action did the team take in response?
options: Nara delayed the journey and opened a dry storage bay for the patients.
Nara refused to irrigate edible crops until the remaining tests were complete.
Tasa insisted that a living seed was a responsibility rather than a trophy.
questions.explanation: 本章團隊的具體做法是「娜拉拒絕在剩餘檢測完成前用該水灌溉食用作物」。這個選擇可由正文推得，並非其他章節採取的措施。

paragraphs.en: That morning, the ruined nursery cooled beneath a thin veil of ash.
